info.name: WePlay.Dashboard.Artista.IntegrationTests
info.description:
Integration tests for the Artist Dashboard API endpoints.

Full dependency chain: Auth -> Artista -> Campania -> Reward -> Publish -> Fan -> Backing -> Dashboard.

Dashboard is READ-ONLY. No POST/PUT/DELETE for dashboard resources.

Endpoints tested:
- GET /api/dashboard/resumen
- GET /api/dashboard/mis-campanias
- GET /api/dashboard/campanias/{id}/backings
- GET /api/dashboard/campanias/{id}/stats
